name: Android keyboard for X11 apps
purpose: Android's keyboard for X11 (Xwayland) apps' text fields - Steam's CEF, GTK/Qt apps on X11 - which have no Wayland text-input. ibus-daemon (GTK on X11 picks IBus by itself; XIM apps through ibus-daemon --xim) learns the text-field focus; powos-ime-bridge is its panel and calls KWin's SetX11TextFocus (pkgs/kwin patch 0016), which shows or hides the keyboard. Typed text comes back as key events.
installedBy: targets/android/install-powos-android.sh (rootfs build) and targets/android/rooted/powos-deploy.sh; ibus itself comes with the rootfs (phone-rules.conf keeps it; input-method engines stay out)

processes.started_by: the Plasma session's autostart (/etc/xdg/autostart/ibus.desktop); it starts ibus-daemon (+ ibus-x11, ibus-engine-simple) as its children

unbounded: a few small session processes, idle unless a key is typed into an X11 app; inside the session's own bound (Android's lmkd)
remove: pkill -f powos-ime-bridge (ends ibus-daemon with it); rm /usr/bin/powos-ime-bridge /etc/xdg/autostart/ibus.desktop /etc/xdg/plasma-workspace/env/ibus.sh /etc/profile.d/60-powos-ime.sh; X11 apps then type without the keyboard coming up
